extension.description: Automatically configures Kodi's TV client for your BGPVR server: Simple Setup (IPTV Simple Client: live TV, guide, catch-up) or Advanced Setup (Tvheadend HTSP Client: adds recordings, timers and the recordings list). Sign in with your phone (scan the QR code Kodi shows and approve the box), or enter your server URL, username and password — Kodi does the rest. Live TV, EPG and recordings all set up in one step. To reconfigure: change settings and restart Kodi.

Автоматично конфигурира ТВ клиента на Kodi за вашия BGPVR сървър: Лесна настройка (IPTV Simple Client) или Разширена настройка (Tvheadend HTSP Client, със записи). Влезте с телефона (сканирайте QR кода и одобрете кутията) или въведете URL на сървъра, потребителско име и парола — Kodi прави останалото.
extension.news: v1.2.0 (6 Nov 2026) - Sign in with your phone: Kodi shows a QR code and a code like ABCD-EFGH; approve the box in My Account (or the BGPVR Player app on the phone) and Kodi sets up Live TV by itself (Simple Setup) - The box gets a sign-in of its own, listed in My Account > Devices as Kodi; signing it out there makes Kodi ask to sign in again at the next start. The account password is never stored on the box - Sign in another way keeps the username and password sign-in; Advanced Setup (recordings) still uses it - Installs that are already set up keep working with no change v1.1.1 (1 Nov 2026) - Advanced Setup connects to the Tvheadend (HTSP) address and port the BGPVR server announces (suite 2.9.419+), so it works when the web address is behind Cloudflare; a manual address in Settings still wins v1.1.0 (1 Nov 2026) - Choose the TV client: Simple Setup (IPTV Simple Client: live TV, guide, catch-up) or Advanced Setup (Tvheadend HTSP Client: adds recordings, timers and the recordings list); asked once at first setup, changeable in Settings > TV client; the other client is disabled - On desktop Linux the TV clients come from the system: Setup shows the one command to run (sudo apt install kodi-pvr-iptvsimple or kodi-pvr-hts) - "Allow self-signed certificate" now takes effect (1.0.4 read it the wrong way on Kodi 19 and newer) v1.0.4 (1 Nov 2026) - Server certificates are checked; new Advanced setting "Allow self-signed certificate (not recommended)", off by default v1.0.3 (31 Oct 2026) - IPTV Simple M3U and EPG addresses use the stream token instead of the password; existing installs are moved over at the next Kodi start
